name: PLTR Enterprise AI Agent Operating System Valuation
rationale: Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR) establishes enterprise ontology moat across defense and Global 2000 commercial sectors with AIP, Gotham, and Foundry. TTM revenue surged +92.8% YoY to $4.48B with elite 49.0% profit margins. At $182.29, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $178.93 (-1.8% variance at 9.35% WACC), perfectly matching market equilibrium. Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 44.1% CAGR. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 5.2 shares, 2.77% target weight). Maintain current position size, accumulate on pullbacks near $160.81, and execute partial trims above $195.00.

bear.rationale: Enterprise AI agent competition from cloud incumbents slows commercial AIP conversion; net margin settles at 30% on $11.1B Y5 revenue.
risks: Hyperscaler-native agent tooling commoditizing generic enterprise workflow automation

base.rationale: AIP and Gotham/Foundry ontology moat scales across US/allied defense and Global 2000 enterprises; revenue expands to $22.4B with 42% net margin.
risks: High valuation multiple leaving minimal margin for quarterly growth deceleration
Customer concentration across large US government agency contracts

bull.rationale: Palantir becomes the undisputed enterprise operating system for autonomous AI agents and sovereign defense; $36.4B revenue at 48% net margin.
risks: Regulatory inquiries into public sector data sovereignty and private AI monopolization
Geopolitical escalations forcing rapid export control adjustments
